en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a rural townscape with fields in the foreground, a small river or pond, and a compact town on gently rising hills in the background. The town includes clustered houses and a prominent church with a tall spire on the right. A rounded hill stands behind the settlement. The lower part of the card is blank except for red Gothic-style German text reading "Gruss aus Altenberg i. Erzgebirge." There is also small vertical printer information along the left margin.
